svg.title: Heartbeat viewport ownership, hierarchy-visible contact, persisted-poll coherence, and interruption chrome truth scars
svg.desc: A non-raster warm-wall diagram showing source-level heartbeat ownership constraints. Horizontal rectangle intersection is not promoted to visible contact when the native control or an ancestor is hidden; the current Operator Overlay owner remains geometry-only at this checkpoint and the exact hierarchy-visibility owner surgery is preserved but unapplied. Persisted-poll, coherent-read, contact-preservation, and waiting-recovery source wiring remain intact. Android runtime, TalkBack behavior, deployment, phone delivery, and P0 recovery remain unproven and untouched.
svg.text: WARM WALL / VISIBLE CONTACT ≠ RECTANGLE INTERSECTION
OWNER GEOMETRY WIRED • HIERARCHY GATE OPEN • TESTED NO • TALKBACK UNCLAIMED • PHONE/P0 UNTOUCHED
CAPTURE
● SELECTED A
□ FOCUSED A
Capture requires shown hierarchy + viewport intersection.
SHOVEL
hidden geometry is not contact
HIDDEN ANCESTOR
× SELECTED A
□ FOCUSED B
A may intersect stale coordinates; shown B must win.
EXISTING OWNER / PARTIAL-UNSAFE CONTACT
Current helper checks horizontal geometry only; it does not yet require control.isShown() / equivalent ancestor visibility.
Exact owner surgery is preserved separately. Until applied, hidden descendants can retain stale geometry and must not be called visible contact.
Selection, keyboard focus, hierarchy visibility, viewport intersection, and TalkBack focus remain distinct evidence states.
No geometry-only Christmas twitch. Source patch ≠ owner wiring. Direct keyboard focus ≠ TalkBack focus.
SOURCE BOUNDS / PARSER = DIRECT TYPED GATE
Oversized direct Candidate → BLOCKED · last-good contact held · motion forbidden · no truncation costume.
ONE MATERIAL ID = ONE OWNER
regnet + REGNET material aliases → REJECTED · no first-wins Button · last-good contact held · no motion.
ROOT PULSE ID / ONE BOUND
parser = direct scene = pre-parser diagnostic · max+1 → REJECTED · attempted ID suppressed · contact held · no motion.
PERSISTED POLL / OWNER SOURCE WIRED
empty before first contact → WAITING · empty after contact → WOUND ONCE · unchanged → NO DECODE / PARSE / UI / SPEECH / MOTION
unexpected projection abort → RETRY · positive timestamp magnitude alone → NO SEMANTIC WORK
COHERENT READ / TYPE TRUTH
one-map owner wired · Float metadata → REJECTED, never silently truncated into byte/timestamp evidence
CHROME TRUTH / EXISTING OWNER WIRED
pre-contact wound → REFRESH BLOCKED · accepted/preserved pulse → CONTACT HELD · summary + detail share one contact truth
WAITING RECOVERY / EXISTING OWNER WIRED
healthy empty store → clear stale pre-contact wound ONCE · reset controls/identities/motion · repeated 200 ms polls stay still
Repository source only. No Android execution, phone execution, queue, P0 recovery, deployment, delivery, or acceptance evidence.
